preservedResponsibilities: Original GetDateRef from zforfind.cxx, operating on the native scanner owner and actual CalendarWrapper. THE_FUTURE and NF_TEST_CALENDAR remain disabled exactly as in the normal upstream build.

B8TCAE adds36 public number-input integration regressions using actual compiled SvNumberformat, language, native-number and calendar owners. Independent civil-date epoch arithmetic checks full/named/incomplete dates, two-digit pivot1950 and original date-evaluation policies; caller-supplied quoted literals test custom-order admission without manufactured token arrays. Ordinary DATESEP patterns and month-only input retain original acceptance gates. The fixed SYSTEM clock supplies2024-06-15 for incomplete dates; no full native input-scanner/UNO ABI parity is claimed.

B8TCAE bounded regression: Real compiled formats exercise incomplete year/day and day/year orders, named-month year/day selection, source short-year fallback, invalid civil dates and date-time fragments. Expected serials are independently computed from civil Gregorian dates and minute fractions; only the host SYSTEM date is fixed. No scanner state or calendar algorithm is replaced.

Additional public compound-input regressions preserve accounting currency sign timing, grouping with scientific exponents, decimal/fraction/category conflicts, malformed numeric/date fragments, ISO date/time transitions and international-first evaluation with a real compiled date format. The two-suite profile passes135 tests. Scalar expectations are independently specified; negative ISO-era dates are checked by a one-day increment rather than a fabricated native absolute-day oracle. No private scanner state, source algorithm, discovery or threshold changes; full native input-scanner parity remains unverified.
omittedResponsibilities: Unconsumed APIs, native ABI/mutex/allocator and undefined-input behavior, complete UNO/display formatting, formatter/column auto-input and final CSV integration remain outside the evidence for this module. No alternate calendar selection or unsupported-known-type error is introduced.

filenameDivergence.rationale: Split the original source responsibility into a TypeScript fragment while retaining the actual source owner, to satisfy file-size and ESM initialization constraints.
